property_summary: For any amounts v0,v1 within a token cap, each recipient must receive its own v[i], so a batch transfer with v0+v1 <= cap succeeds; the mutant sends v[0] to everyone and reverts whenever 2*v0 > cap (possible whenever v0 > v1).
change_summary: Replace v[i] with v[0] in the transferFrom call so every recipient receives the first amount.
